definition.whenToUse: The default block, and the one to reach for whenever the source is simply written. Prose carries anything Markdown carries. Choose a structured block only when the source itself is structured, never to make a plain passage look busier.

brief.description: The passage, in Markdown, taken from the source. Headings, lists, emphasis and links are all allowed. Never rewrite the source's meaning, and never add facts it does not state.
